Lumi the firefly, so small and bright,
Flew out to play in the dark of night.
Her little light, a tiny spark,
Shining bright even in the dark park.

A grumpy toad sat on a stone,
Feeling sad and all alone.
"My flower’s wilted, my day is bad,"
He croaked, feeling terribly sad.

Lumi blinked, a golden hue,
"I'll help you!  It's what friends do!"
She whispered a magical rhyme so sweet,
"Shiny dew, oh shiny treat!"

A sprinkle of fairy dust appeared,
All the toad's sadness disappeared.
The flower bloomed, so big and grand,
Holding pixie treasure in its hand.

Lumi, feeling brave and new,
Saw a shadow, big and blue.
She worried then, inside her heart,
Afraid to play another part.

But then she remembered what she knew,
That even small lights see us through.
So she shone her brightest little beam,
The shadow vanished like a dream.

Lumi, the hero, felt so bold,
A story of bravery to be told.
She danced among the stars so high,
A brave little firefly in the night sky.
